fields.Format: AN
fields.Field Explanation: SHARP CONTRAST WITH FORM 350. The instruction guide (Res. 000022/2024) says this number is 'asignado por la natural person o juridica que expide la certificacion' - the EMPLOYER assigns it, not DIAN. On Form 350 casilla 4 is DIAN-assigned and opaque. The engine must therefore maintain its own certificate numbering series and keep it stable, because the employee quotes it. FORMAT: DIAN prescribes no format for this number and the value is alphanumeric (instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024). COMPOSITE KEY - position breakdown. Because DIAN prescribes NO structure, the series is Mercans-designed and is fixed here so that it is stable and auditable: positions 1-4 = accrual year AAAA, source PayPeriod.Fiscal_Year, the year the income was earned and NOT the year of issue; position 5 = literal hyphen; positions 6-11 = a six-digit zero-filled consecutive, source Mercans.Certificate_Sequence, restarting at 000001 for each accrual year and unique per employer per year. PERSISTENCE: assigned once and NEVER reused, including after a reissue - a replacement certificate takes the NEXT consecutive and cites the superseded number, because ET art. 378 makes the employee's copy the document that proves the withholding and two certificates may not share a number.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Format: N (no dots, no hyphens, no DV)
fields.Field Explanation: NIT of the withholding agent as it appears in casilla 5 of the RUT, WITHOUT the verification digit. The instruction guide is emphatic: 'En ningun caso escriba puntos, guiones o letras'.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Format: N
fields.Field Explanation: Verification digit as it appears in casilla 6 of the RUT.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only where the withholding agent is a NATURAL person. Mutually exclusive with 'Corporate name' (casilla 11), which the instruction guide says a natural person must NOT fill.
fields.Format: A
fields.Field Explanation: First surname of a natural-person agent, matching casilla 31 of the RUT. The instruction guide directs that where it does not match, THE RUT MUST BE UPDATED BEFORE THE CERTIFICATE IS ISSUED - the form does not override the register.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only for a natural-person agent. Mutually exclusive with 'Corporate name' (casilla 11).
fields.Format: A
fields.Field Explanation: Second surname, matching casilla 32 of the RUT.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only for a natural-person agent. Mutually exclusive with 'Corporate name' (casilla 11).
fields.Format: A
fields.Field Explanation: First given name, matching casilla 33 of the RUT.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only for a natural-person agent. Mutually exclusive with 'Corporate name' (casilla 11).
fields.Format: A
fields.Field Explanation: Remaining given names, matching casilla 34 of the RUT.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only where the withholding agent is a LEGAL person or a sociedad de hecho. The instruction guide states that a natural-person issuer 'no debe diligenciar esta casilla'. Mutually exclusive with casillas 7 to 10.
fields.Format: A
fields.Field Explanation: Full corporate name (razon social) of the withholding agent, matching casilla 35 of the RUT; source Company.Legal_Name. Populated only for a legal person or sociedad de hecho. Do NOT derive it from a payroll organisation label or company-code description: such labels carry an internal company-code prefix and are not the RUT name. The same value feeds 'Payer or withholding agent name' on the signature line.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Format: N (code)
fields.Field Explanation: The instruction guide (Res. 000022/2024) prints a SIX-VALUE list on the form itself, and only those six codes are output: 12 Tarjeta de identidad, 13 Cedula de ciudadania, 21 Tarjeta de extranjeria, 22 Cedula de extranjeria, 31 NIT, 41 Pasaporte. That is NARROWER than the electronic payroll list at Annex table 5.2.1, which also carries 11 Record civil, 42 Foreign identity document, 47 PEP, 50 NIT de otro pais and 91 NUIP: a document outside the six-value list (PEP, PPT) is not a document type of this form and is not certified under any other code. A foreign employee is certified with the admitted document held - 21 Tarjeta de extranjeria, 22 Cedula de extranjeria or 41 Pasaporte. SOURCE: the employee master holds one document-number field per document type ('National ID', 'Identity Card', 'Indentity Card for Foreigners', 'Citizenship Card ID') and no document-type field, and more than one of them may be populated for the same employee. The engine stores an explicit Employee.Document_Type for the document actually certified in casilla 25, never inferred from which field is filled. The mapping of the employee master document fields to the Form 220 codes is maintained as a configuration table: 'Citizenship Card ID' -> 13 and 'Indentity Card for Foreigners' -> 22; 'National ID' and 'Identity Card' have no direct Form 220 code.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Format: N / AN
fields.Field Explanation: Identification number exactly as it appears on the identity document of the type in casilla 24, held as text (no dots, hyphens or spaces). Join key to the electronic payroll NIE045, to PILA Record Tipo 2 campo 4 and to Format 2276 numeral 2. SOURCE: the document-number field of the employee master that matches the document type in casilla 24 ('Citizenship Card ID', 'Indentity Card for Foreigners', 'National ID' or 'Identity Card'), selected through Employee.Document_Type. Do NOT use the internal employee number ('Employee ID' / 'ID Number'): it is a payroll key, not an identity document. The casilla is mandatory: a blank document number is rejected as a data error. PAYEES OUTSIDE THE EMPLOYEE MASTER (pension payees and other non-employee payees): casilla 25 and the split names of casillas 26-29 are taken from the identity source maintained for that payee population (the pensioner master), which holds the document type, the document number and the four name parts. Where a pension is paid to a beneficiary other than the pensioner, the certificate is issued in the name of the person who receives the pension, whose document and names are certified here (see casilla 50).
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Format: A
fields.Field Explanation: First surname exactly as on the identity document.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Format: A
fields.Field Explanation: Second surname. Not mandatory here, in contrast with the electronic payroll where it is use=required.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Format: A
fields.Field Explanation: First given name exactly as on the identity document.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Format: A
fields.Field Explanation: Remaining given names.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Format: AAAA MM DD
fields.Field Explanation: First day of the certified period, output as AAAA MM DD. Normally 1 January of the tax year, but the start date of the employment relationship where the employee joined during the year. Bidirectional pair with casilla 31. SOURCE: Master Data field 'Hire Date' (format DD-MM-YYYY, converted to AAAA MM DD) - the start of the employment relationship current in the tax year; the source date field is held as a configuration setting of the engine, with 'Hire Date' as its value. 'Original Hire Date' (DD-MM-YYYY) and 'Adjusted Service Date' (YYYY-MM-DD) refer to earlier or adjusted service and do not define the certified period.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Format: AAAA MM DD
fields.Field Explanation: Last day of the certified period. Normally 31 December, but the termination date where the employee left during the year. Bidirectional pair with casilla 30.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Format: AAAA MM DD
fields.Field Explanation: Date the certificate is issued, in year-month-day order. Must be on or before the LAST BUSINESS DAY OF MARCH following the fiscal year - the statutory deadline.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Field Name (EN): Place where the withholding was made
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Lugar donde se practico la retencion
fields.Format: A
fields.Field Explanation: City or municipality where the withholding was practised (instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024) - not necessarily the employer's registered domicile, and not necessarily the employee's place of work. It is a withholding-agent parameter, held as an employer configuration setting (the five-digit DIVIPOLA code of the place of withholding), not an employee attribute. Output the municipality NAME, in upper case without accents, that corresponds to the DANE code of casillas 34 and 35, so that the three casillas always describe the same place.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Format: N (DANE)
fields.Field Explanation: DANE department code of the place in casilla 33: the FIRST TWO digits of the five-digit DIVIPOLA municipality code. The instruction guide (Res. 000022/2024) directs the use of the DANE 'Department codes' tables for casillas 34 and 35: both casillas carry DANE codes. Hold the five-digit DIVIPOLA code of the place of withholding once (e.g. 11001 Bogota D.C.) and split it - casilla 34 = the first two digits ('11'), casilla 35 = the last three ('001') - never output five digits in either casilla.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Format: N (DANE)
fields.Field Explanation: DANE municipality code of the place in casilla 33: the LAST THREE digits of the five-digit DIVIPOLA code (e.g. '001' for 11001 Bogota D.C.). Like PILA and unlike the electronic payroll, Form 220 splits the DIVIPOLA code across two casillas. The five-digit code is held once and split before output - see casilla 34 for the split rule; never output five digits in this casilla.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Total salary payments ACTUALLY MADE in the period to a resident natural person whose income derives from an employment or statutory relationship. The instruction guide (Res. 000022/2024) quotes CST art. 127 in full: salary is not only the ordinary fixed or variable remuneration but everything the employee receives in money or in kind as direct consideration for the service - primas, sobresueldos, habitual bonuses, overtime, work on mandatory rest days, sales percentages and commissions. EXCLUSION RULE: do NOT include here any value belonging in casillas 38 to 46. SOURCE: salary wage types 62100 Ordinary Salary, 62101 Arrears - Ordinary salary, 62140 Integral Salary (the full integral salary, including the factor prestacional), 62141 Arrears-Integral Salary, 62118 Incentive Compensation - IC Local Country, 62133 Variable, 62113 Weekend payoff and 62841 / 62842 / 62845 overtime and night, Sunday or holiday surcharges. BONUSES: HABITUAL bonuses are salary and are certified here - 62208 March Bonus, 62209 Christmas Bonus, 62210 August Bonus, 62225 Salary Attendance Bonus-Monthly, 62224 Quarterly Salary Attendance Bonus and 62228 Years of Service Bonus - CLA; NON-HABITUAL bonuses are certified in casilla 46 - 62202 Ocassional Bonus Grossed Up (instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024). 62229 Years of Service Bonus NON CLA is certified here where habitual and in casilla 46 where not; the habitual attribute of that bonus wage type comes from the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC). PAYMENTS IN KIND: an in-kind payment that is salary under CST art. 127 is certified here and an in-kind payment that is not salary is certified in casilla 46; the salary attribute of each in-kind wage type comes from the WTC (meal payments follow the 310 / 41 UVT test of casillas 37-38). LEAVE PAYOUTS 79405-79419 (marriage, maternity, paternity, sick-leave, bereavement, paid and jury leave payouts) and SALARY PAID ABROAD to expatriates (25830 Salary paid in Foreign Countries, 65838 Incentive Compensation - IC-1001 Foreign Country) follow the same rule as every other earning: certified here where the WTC classifies the wage type as salary and in casilla 46 where it classifies it as non-salary work income. The wage-type attribute 'Salary Payment Indicator' must NOT be used as the casilla-36 rule on its own: it is also set on vacation pay (79401 Annual leave payout, 62116 Vacation Terminations, 62150 Vacation Bonus), which is certified in casilla 42, and on per diems (62805-62808), which are always certified in casilla 43, and on the leave payouts 79405-79419; and it is absent from the bonus wage types 62229, 62224 and 62202 listed above. The engine holds an explicit wage-type-to-casilla table, maintained as a configuration table from the WTC attributes; every earning wage type is assigned. PERIOD: sum the payments made from 1 January to 31 December of the tax year; never a rolling 12-month total.
fields.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instruction guide directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

fields.Field Name (EN): Payments made with vouchers, cheques, cards or vales
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos realizados con bonos electronicos o de papel de servicio, cheques, tarjetas, vales, etc.
fields.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Payments made in electronic or paper service vouchers, cheques, cards or vales - for fuel, school supplies, footwear and clothing, or any other purpose. Deductible for the employer and income for the employee. THREE EXPLICIT NOTES in the instruction guide: (1) INCLUDE meal payments for an employee earning MORE than 310 UVT per month; (2) do NOT include meal payments for an employee earning up to 310 UVT - those go to casilla 38; (3) do NOT include anything already reported in casilla 36. SOURCE: in-kind benefits paid to third parties are booked as informative earning wage types ('Inf.') offset by an equal informative deduction - e.g. 65818 Meal Allowance Inf.-2079 offset by 21115 Meal Allowance Inf. Deduction-2644 - and the same pattern applies to 65811 Gym Allowance Inf.-6969, 65809 / 65839 Optical Allowance Inf, 65812 Text Books Allowance - Inf-6971, 65801 / 65814 / 65815 / 65831 Private Health Insurance Inf and 65817 / 65837 Life Insurance-Inf. The earning side is the certified value; the offsetting deduction wage types are payroll mechanics and are not themselves casilla values. The meal item 65818 is subject to the 41 UVT / 310 UVT test of casillas 37-38, applied month by month: in a month in which the employee's salary exceeds 310 UVT the whole 65818 amount is certified here; in a month in which it does not, nothing is certified here and the excess over 41 UVT goes to casilla 38 (instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024; ET art. 387-1). The other in-kind benefit wage types listed above (gym, optical, text books, private health insurance and life insurance) are not subject to the meal test and are not certified here: each is certified in casilla 36 where the WTC classifies the wage type as salary and in casilla 46 where it classifies it as non-salary work income (instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024: casilla 36 covers everything received in kind as direct consideration for the service, casilla 46 the work-income payments with no dedicated casilla); the salary attribute of each in-kind wage type comes from the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC).
fields.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instruction guide directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

fields.Field Name (EN): Excess meal payments over 41 UVT (ET art. 387-1)
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Valor del exceso de los pagos por alimentacion mayores a 41 UVT, art. 387-1 E.T.
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only where meal payments to a third party exceed 41 UVT in a month AND the employee's salary does not exceed 310 UVT. Bidirectional pair with casilla 37: where the salary exceeds 310 UVT the WHOLE meal payment goes to casilla 37 instead, and casilla 38 stays nil.
fields.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Where the employer pays a THIRD PARTY for the employee's or their family's meals - a restaurant, own or third-party, or vouchers for food - the payment is deductible for the employer and is NOT income for the employee but for the supplier, PROVIDED the employee's salary does not exceed 310 UVT (COP 16,235,940 per month in 2026). Where the monthly payments exceed 41 UVT (COP 2,147,334 in 2026), THE EXCESS is taxable income of the employee and is withheld as employment income. The instruction guide adds that the rule does not apply to company representation expenses, which remain deductible. Do NOT include amounts already in casilla 36. SOURCE: wage type 65818 Meal Allowance Inf.-2079, taken per employee per month. Run the test MONTH BY MONTH per employee: the month's meal payment against 41 UVT and the employee's monthly salary against 310 UVT, using the UVT parameter of the tax year (52,374 for 2026); do NOT read the UVT from wage type 58001 UVT, which is a per-run payroll amount and is multiplied in months with more than one payroll run or a retro run. The casilla is the sum of the monthly excesses over the tax year.
fields.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instruction guide directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only where the employer paid fees to this natural person. Not employment income; present because Form 220 certifies all work income of ET art. 383, not only employment income.
fields.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Fees paid to natural persons providing services in which the INTELLECTUAL factor predominates over the technical, material, manual or mechanical - typically a professional qualification or substantial expertise in a field. The instruction guide also directs that ECCLESIASTICAL EMOLUMENTS be included here, in money or in kind, direct or indirect, whatever the denomination and whatever the religious orientation.
fields.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instruction guide directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only where the employer paid such services to this natural person.
fields.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Payments for services - any activity, labour or work performed WITHOUT an employment relationship, resulting in an obligation to do, in which the technical and manual predominate over the intellectual.
fields.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instruction guide directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only where the employer paid non-employment commissions to this natural person. Mutually exclusive with casilla 36 for the same amount.
fields.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Commissions - remuneration for acts, operations, dealings, mandates, business or sales carried out in one's own name but for the account of another, whether or not commercial. NOTE: commissions paid UNDER AN EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT are salary under CST art. 127 and belong in casilla 36; this casilla is for non-employment commissions.
fields.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instruction guide directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

fields.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Statutory benefits OTHER THAN severance savings and the interest on them. The instruction guide (Res. 000022/2024) lists service bonus, vacaciones and work clothing among them, and directs expressly that severance savings paid to the employee go to casilla 47 and severance savings deposited to the fund go elsewhere. VACATION PAY is certified here: wage types 79401 Annual leave payout, 62116 Vacation Terminations and 62150 Vacation Bonus, which carry the 'Salary Payment Indicator' attribute and are nonetheless certified here and not in casilla 36, under the casilla-36 exclusion rule. RECORDED DEFECT: the instruction guide for THIS casilla says the deposited severance goes to 'la casilla 48', but the form's own printed label makes casilla 48 the TRADITIONAL-REGIME severance and casilla 49 the amount deposited to the fund. The form layout is authoritative.
fields.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instruction guide directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated where per diems were paid in the period. Related to the electronic payroll paired elements NIE072 / NIE073, which split the same amount by salary character.
fields.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Per diems paid to cover transport, subsistence and accommodation while the employee works away from the habitual place of work. Per diems are ALWAYS certified here, whatever their salary character (instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024). The instruction guide cites Ministry of Labour Concept 23959 of 13 February. Note the split that matters elsewhere: the PERMANENT portion is salary under CST art. 130 and feeds the contribution base, while the accidental portion does not - the electronic payroll carries them as the paired ViaticoManuAlojS / NS elements. SOURCE: wage types 62805 Hotel per diem, 62806 Breakfast per diem, 62807 Lunch per diem and 62808 Dinner per diem. These carry the 'Salary Payment Indicator' attribute; they are nonetheless reported here and not in casilla 36, under the casilla-36 exclusion rule.
fields.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instruction guide directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated where representation expenses were paid in the period.
fields.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Representation expenses paid to the employee. The instruction guide notes at casilla 38 that company representation expenses are deductible for the company and fall outside the meal-payment rule of ET art. 387-1.
fields.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instruction guide directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos por compensaciones por el trabajo asociado cooperativo
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only for a member of an associated-work cooperative - PILA contributor type 31 and electronic payroll TipoTrabajador 31.
fields.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Compensation for associated cooperative work. Corresponds to the electronic payroll Compensacion elements (NIE149 / NIE150) and applies only to worker type 31.
fields.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instruction guide directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated where a work-income payment has no dedicated casilla.
fields.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Work-income payments not falling in any other casilla. Use sparingly: DIAN expects a concept with a dedicated casilla to use that casilla. Certified here (instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024): (a) NON-HABITUAL BONUSES - 62202 Ocassional Bonus Grossed Up; habitual bonuses are salary and go to casilla 36; 62229 Years of Service Bonus NON CLA is certified here where non-habitual and in casilla 36 where habitual, and the habitual attribute of that bonus wage type comes from the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC). (b) PAYMENTS TO RETIREES THAT ARE NOT A PENSION - 62151 Retirement Payment - PRV-6795, 62152 Retirement Payment - Catleya-6796, 62115 Retirement Allowance, 62830 Pensioner Allowance-6794 and 62155 Medical Plan - Healthcare Insurance (EPS ) Pensioner- PMI Offset Compensation; the pension itself (62154 Monthly Retired  Pension-6798 and 62153 Additional Retirement Pension) is certified in casilla 50, never here (see casilla 50). (c) PAYMENTS IN KIND THAT ARE NOT SALARY - an in-kind payment that is salary under CST art. 127 is certified in casilla 36 instead; the salary attribute of each in-kind wage type comes from the WTC (meal payments follow the 310 / 41 UVT test of casillas 37-38). (d) EARNINGS WITH NO DEDICATED CASILLA - 62131 Scholarship-6861, 62700 School Allowance-6839, 62590 Marriage Allowance-6801, 62591 Child Birth Allowance-6002, 62112 Family Burial Allowance-6319, 62811 Health Allowance-6473, 62523 Transportation Allowance CLA- 2008, 62540 Housing Allowance Domestic Relocation-2087, 62310 Expat allowance 5526, 62320 Leasing Expat Allowance Inf-5524, 65821 Expatriation Package for Inbounds, 65800 Stock awards (Vesting) - Informative-1004, 62138 Dividend payment (stock awards) -1003, 62180 / 62181 Severance/Layoff Payment (dismissal indemnity) and 62837 Leave payout: each is certified in casilla 36 where the WTC classifies the wage type as salary, in casilla 42 where it classifies it as a statutory benefit (prestacion social), here where it classifies it as other work income, and is not certified on this form where it classifies it as income that is not work income. The engine holds an explicit wage-type-to-casilla table, maintained as a configuration table from the WTC attributes; no earning wage type may be left unassigned.
fields.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instruction guide directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

fields.Field Name (EN): Severance savings and interest paid to the employee
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Auxilio de cesantia e intereses efectivamente pagados al empleado
fields.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Cesantias_Paid_To_Employee [WTC: CO-CESANTIAS (severance principal, paid directly only on termination/partial settlement) + CO-INTERESES-CESANTIAS (interest, paid directly each January and with every direct payment of cesantias)]
fields.Field Explanation: THE FIRST OF THREE SEVERANCE LINES. Severance savings and the interest on them ACTUALLY PAID to the employee in the period - typically the January interest payment and any authorised partial withdrawal or termination settlement. Excluded from the monthly withholding base under ET art. 206 num. 4 but still certified here. SOURCE: wage types 62110 Cash-out of Severance Pay - Social Benefits -541S and 62117 Cash-out of Interest Severance Pay - Social Benefits-541R (termination and settlement payments), 62126 Advance Severance Last Year (authorised partial payments) and 62127 Advance Interest Severance Pay (the annual interest on severance, paid in January). Provision wage types (22110, 22112, 42110, 42112) and balance wage types (63814, 63815, 64999, 68028) are accruals or balances, not payments, and are not certified here. An employee on integral salary (WT 62140 Integral Salary) accrues no cesantias and no interest for the time on integral salary (CST art. 132 num. 2), so nothing is certified here for that time, including on termination; only cesantias and interest settled for the service before the conversion to integral salary (CST art. 132 num. 4) are certified here. The integral salary itself is certified in full in casilla 36. Interest on cesantias is paid with every direct payment of cesantias - WT 62117 on termination, or within the month following a partial settlement (Ley 52 de 1975 art. 1) - and not only as the January interest of WT 62127.
fields.Option Values: -> Sheet 6: Las tres lineas de severance savings
fields.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instruction guide directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

fields.Field Name (EN): Severance savings under the traditional CST regime
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Auxilio de cesantia reconocido a trabajadores del regimen tradicional del Codigo Sustantivo del Trabajo, contenido en el Capitulo VII, Titulo VIII Parte Primera
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only for an employee under the pre-1991 traditional severance regime. Mutually exclusive with 'Severance savings deposited to the fund' (casilla 49) for the same employee: a traditional-regime employee has no annual fund deposit.
fields.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Cesantias_Traditional_Regime [No dedicated WTC code -- a regime-eligibility flag (traditional CST annual-fund regime), not itself a wage type]
fields.Field Explanation: THE SECOND OF THREE SEVERANCE LINES. Severance RECOGNISED - not necessarily paid - to employees remaining under the pre-1991 retroactive regime of CST Chapter VII, Title VIII, Part One, rather than the Ley 50 de 1990 annual-deposit regime. A shrinking but real population: employees hired before 1 January 1991 who did not elect the new regime.
fields.Option Values: -> Sheet 6: Las tres lineas de severance savings
fields.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instruction guide directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

fields.Field Name (EN): Severance savings deposited to the fund
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Auxilio de cesantia consignado al fondo de cesantias
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated for an employee under the Ley 50 de 1990 regime. Mutually exclusive with 'Severance savings under the traditional CST regime' (casilla 48) for the same employee. Must reconcile to the amount actually deposited under CO-CESANTIAS-006.
fields.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Cesantias_Deposited_To_Fund [WTC: CO-PROV-CESANTIAS, the employer accrual deposited to the chosen fund]
fields.Field Explanation: THE THIRD OF THREE SEVERANCE LINES. Severance savings DEPOSITED to the employee's chosen severance fund IN THE TAX YEAR, under Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99. The deposit made by 14 February for the balance at the preceding 31 December belongs to the tax year in which it is deposited, not to the year of accrual: severance income is realised on deposit to the fund (ET art. 27 num. 3; instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024). The certificate for tax year N therefore carries the deposit made by 14 February of year N (balance at 31 December of year N-1); the deposit made by 14 February of year N+1 belongs to the certificate for year N+1. The engine must maintain all three buckets - paid to the employee, traditional regime, deposited to the fund - separately from the outset; they cannot be split retrospectively out of a single cesantias figure. SOURCE: wage type 25827 Payment Severance Funds Inf. (mirrored by 65805 with the same amount - take one, not both), paid in February and certified in the tax year of that payment. fields.Field Explanation: THE ROLLING SIX-MONTH AVERAGE that drives the ET art. 206 num. 4 severance exemption and its taper. fields.Field Explanation: THE PRINCIPAL WITHHOLDING CASILLA. Total withholding at source ACTUALLY PRACTISED on this employee's work and pension income during the certified period; no hypothetical, theoretical or contingent amount is certified (instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024). Feeds casilla 75 together with casilla 74. Must reconcile to twelve months of electronic payroll NIE177 for this employee, and the sum of casilla 60 across all employees must reconcile to twelve months of Form 350 casilla 93 - allowing for the rounding conventions. SOURCE: the withholding practised is wage type 2552 Income Tax (employee) plus 21129 Personal Income Tax Withholding-Terminations- 541T (a separate deduction on termination payments, which can coexist with 2552 in the same month) and 21140 Personal Income Tax Withholding-Retirees- 6799. Wage types 21330 Personal Income Tax Withholding (Theoretical) and 25834 Hypothetical Witholding Tax  - IC Foreign Country are notional, not withholding practised, and are NOT certified; the same exclusion applies to every wage type that computes a theoretical, hypothetical or contingent withholding. Wage types 25832 / 65832 Witholding Tax on Stock awards and 25833 Witholding Tax  - IC Local Country are certified here where the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC) classifies the wage type as withholding actually deducted from the employee's income, and are excluded where it classifies the wage type as theoretical, hypothetical, contingent or informative; the withholding-practised attribute of each comes from the WTC. Only the withholding actually deducted is certified: a comparison result computed without the contribution depuration, and any contingent withholding derived from it, is not part of 2552 and is not certified. Sum January to December of the tax year; never a rolling 12-month total.

fields.Field Name (EN): ═══ employee certification under et art. 380 - display-only declarations ═══

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Certifico que durante el ano gravable (6 items)
fields.Conditional Reason: The employee signs these ONLY where they intend the certificate to substitute for their income-tax return under DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.6.1.13.2.7. All six must be true together.
fields.Position (Start-End): Printed block above the employee's signature
fields.Format: Display-only declaration
fields.Field Explanation: DISPLAY-ONLY - not a data field, not populated by payroll, not transmitted. The six declarations are: (1) gross wealth did not exceed 4,500 UVT; (2) gross income was below 1,400 UVT; (3) not a VAT-responsible person at 31 December; (4) credit-card consumption did not exceed 1,400 UVT; (5) total purchases and consumption did not exceed 1,400 UVT; (6) total bank deposits, receipts or financial investments did not exceed 1,400 UVT. Where all six hold, the note on the form states that THIS CERTIFICATE SUBSTITUTES FOR ALL LEGAL PURPOSES for the income-tax return. THIS IS THE ONLY REASON THE EMPLOYEE-DECLARED SECTIONS EXIST ON THE FORM.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.
